messages:
anna_ml: Quick follow-up from the precision scheduling RFC — we need to pick a concrete policy for FP8 vs INT8 fallbacks. Two options on the table: scheduler-driven lanes (pack-level) or request-driven negotiable precision. Thoughts?

 diego_infra: Scheduler lanes win for packing efficiency and stable latency. hard to get per-request quality control though.

 mira_prod: We've started seeing hallucination spikes when FP8 hits certain summarization paths. Need a clear fallback mechanism tied to quality signals.

 jules: Can we tie fallback triggers to deg_score / embedding drift? My proposal: per-endpoint error thresholds + a canary shadow sampling approach.

 ops_oncall: Important ops constraint: if we fallback straight to FP16 costs will blow up. prefer staged fallback: fp8 -> int8 -> fp16, and reduce max_tokens during higher bit lanes.

 quant-bot: [auto] Experiment summary: fp8 vs fp16 on summarization-v2 — median latency -12%, perplexity +3%, hallucination incidents up by 1.8x on edge prompts.

 anna_ml: Proposal: define a policy DSL with 'lanes' (fp8,int8,fp16), 'triggers' (deg_score, token_confidence, p50 latency, retry_count), cooldowns, and a 'cost_cap_pct' to prevent runaway cost.

 diego_infra: Implementation notes: scheduler needs to accept lane hints to pack effectively. also requests must carry a 'quality_budget' int 0-100 for per-request overrides.

 mira_prod: How do we calibrate deg_score? We need a labeled prompt seed set and periodic re-evals. Also want 'shadow' eval buckets to surface regressions at ~1% traffic.

 jules: Shadow eval works — run side-by-side outputs and diff (embeddings/f1/rouge depending on task). escalate if drift > threshold.

 ops_oncall: :thumbsup: Playbook idea: on quality regression: rollback to last stable lane, create incident if regression > 2x baseline for >5 minutes.

 diego_infra: Example DSL stub:
```
lanes:
  - name: fp8
    max_cpu: 8
    fallbacks: [int8]
triggers:
  deg_score: {threshold: 0.8, window: 300}
  latency: {p50_ms: 120}
cooldown: 600
cost_cap_pct: 15
```

 anna_ml: I'll draft the RFC update with examples + the metrics we need. Need a canary prompt list + 1% shadow set. @mira_prod can you own compiling the seed set?

 mira_prod: On it — will collect ~200 diverse samples across docs / chat / summarization. ETA EOD Thu.

 jules: Additions: per-customer overrides (for Dedicated) and a per-route 'max_cost_increase' param.

 ops_oncall: Also require telemetry hooks: per-lane token breakdowns, deg_score trends, latency histograms, rollback counts.

 anna_ml: Great. Will update RFC and schedule a quick infra sync this afternoon. Thanks all :eyes:
